field.label: Gateway connection status
field.help: Track each monitored WAN gateway independently, including backup connections. Notify after an offline or recovered state is confirmed. Recovery messages include outage duration and available connection statistics.

field.label: Gateway latency and packet loss
field.help: Notify when monitored WAN gateways develop excessive latency or packet loss, and when quality returns to normal. Uses the current OPNsense gateway status with log fallback.

field.label: WAN IP address changes
field.help: Notify when the WAN connection logs a change of public IP address. Some connection types do not record this event.

field.label: VPN connection status
field.help: Notify when a supported VPN service logs a disconnection, reconnection or connection error. Available events depend on the VPN service.

field.label: Firewall Alias update alerts
field.help: Read configured URL Table aliases and their local downloaded lists. Warn if a list is missing, empty or older than the maximum age. No lists are updated by this plugin.

field.label: Firewall Alias maximum age
field.help: Largest allowed age of downloaded URL Table lists, in hours. Set above the scheduled refresh interval. Default 48 hours.
